record.bible_text: Behold my servant<WH05650>, whom I uphold<WH08551><WTH8799>; mine elect<WH0972>, <FI>in whom<Fi> my soul<WH05315> delighteth<WH07521><WTH8804>; I have put<WH05414><WTH8804> my spirit<WH07307> upon him: he shall bring forth<WH03318><WTH8686> judgment<WH04941> to the Gentiles<WH01471>.

To open<WH06491><WTH8800> the blind<WH05787> eyes<WH05869>, to bring out<WH03318><WTH8687> the prisoners<WH0616> from the prison<WH04525>, <FI>and<Fi> them that sit<WH03427><WTH8802> in darkness<WH02822> out of the prison<WH03608> house<WH01004>.

Behold, the former things<WH07223> are come to pass<WH0935><WTH8804>, and new things<WH02319> do I declare<WH05046><WTH8688>: before they spring forth<WH06779><WTH8799> I tell<WH08085><WTH8686> you of them.

Sing<WH07891><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068> a new<WH02319> song<WH07892>, <FI>and<Fi> his praise<WH08416> from the end<WH07097> of the earth<WH0776>, ye that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the sea<WH03220>, and all that is therein<WH04393>; the isles<WH0339>, and the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> thereof. <RF>all...: Heb. the fulness thereof<Rf>
